mapper.sql: h.*, e.equip_code, e.equip_name, r.repair_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_attach a WHERE (a.ref_type = 'HISTORY' AND a.ref_id = h.hist_id) OR (h.repair_id IS NOT NULL AND a.ref_type = 'REPAIR' AND a.ref_id = h.repair_id)) AS attach_count
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM equipment_history h JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_id = h.equip_id LEFT JOIN equipment_repair_hist r ON r.repair_id = h.repair_id
AND h.work_dt >= #{from} AND h.work_dt < #{to} AND h.equip_id = #{equipId} AND h.hist_type = #{histType}
AND (h.hist_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.worker_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.reg_user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.reg_user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY h.work_dt DESC, h.hist_id DESC
SELECT FROM equipment_history h JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_id = h.equip_id LEFT JOIN equipment_repair_hist r ON r.repair_id = h.repair_id WHERE h.hist_id = #{histId}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(hist_no, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM equipment_history WHERE hist_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_history (hist_no, equip_id, hist_type, title, content, work_dt, worker_name, repair_id, reg_user_id, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{histNo}, #{equipId}, #{histType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{workDt}, #{workerName}, #{repairId}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName})
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment_history SET equip_id = #{equipId}, hist_type = #{histType}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, work_dt = #{workDt}, worker_name = #{workerName}, upd_user_id = #{updUserId}, upd_user_name = #{updUserName} WHERE hist_id = #{histId}
